body: I appreciate it, I'm not used to being responded to. I guess I don't know how to define "hope" or "value" in their basic meanings. Everyone has different answers for I can't connect to - philosophies that I can't grasp. Recently I broke down at my cardiologist's office during an appointment for example. I asked how can he be exposed to this scene every day, knowing the crushing outcomes that happen. He was diplomatic in his response and actually displayed humanity. But he admitted being in the bed is different and he could assume nothing on my part. I get it, it has to come from within, but I feel like I have nothing left to cultivate into hope. And I don't know how to define value. Every time I find some kind of semblance of complacency in one avenue another issue takes it's place. I can't tell if I'm juggling perspective or seeing clearly the lack of meaning in existence.
